intervals.label: hosting CONNIE
intervals.note: Start is the year the CONNIE prototype was installed at the site ("late 2014"); the plant itself (Angra 1 and Angra 2) is older and its dates were not sourced. The interval is open because no source consulted says the plant has stopped.
intervals.quote: The engineering prototype of the experiment was installed at the reactor site in late 2014

name: Almirante Alvaro Alberto Nuclear Power Plant (Angra)

summary.plain: The Brazilian nuclear power complex at Angra dos Reis, whose Angra 2 reactor is the source for the CONNIE experiment, which tries to catch the faintest nuclear recoils from reactor antineutrinos with silicon sensors 30 metres from the core.
summary.technical: Almirante Alvaro Alberto Nuclear Power Plant, Angra dos Reis, Rio de Janeiro state, Brazil; Angra 2 has a thermal power of 3.8 GW and hosts the CONNIE CCD array in a shipping container outside the reactor building, 30 m from the core.
